sql: select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) as series, count(*) as snaps, count(raw_json->'exchange_index') as has_idx, jsonb_agg(distinct raw_json->'exchange_index') as idx_values from market_snapshots where captured_at > now() - interval '2 days' and split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXMLBHR','KXMLBTOTAL','KXMLBSPREAD','KXITFMATCH','KXBTCD','KXNCAAFSPREAD','KXLALIGASCORE') group by 1 order by 1
